notes.title: Green Lava's 10th Anniversary!
notes.notes:
Hey y’all,

We still can’t believe it, but this week Green Lava Studios is turning a decade old! From the deepest crevices of our souls and hearts, we are thankful with everyone, every single player, for supporting our work!

As part of this celebration, all our games are on sale! Give ‘em a look here:
https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Green%20Lava%20Studios

Once again, this wouldn’t be possible without you all. The team is working on new, weird games and we will definitely let you know of our plans soon; we can’t wait to reveal what the future holds for our little studio. Alongside copious amounts of coffee, you all are the fuel for these projects!

Finally, we want to give special thanks to Steam, for giving us the opportunity to distribute our games worldwide from sunny Costa Rica. 

Cheers and hugs,
The Green Lava Team

notes.title: Fenix Rage demo and soundtrack is now available!
notes.notes:
Gamers around the galaxy are lovin’ every frustrating moment that Fenix Rage offers and there’s good reason: unique jumping and dashing mechanics, vivid graphic and art style, and that addicting “just one more try” gameplay have hooked players hard.  And let’s not forget the rocking tunes! 

Ask and receive, kind folks - available now for the sweet price of $1.99, the Official Fenix Rage Game Soundtrack delivers 32 chiptune, guitar tracks from the various menus, levels, and in-game cut scenes.  From the air-guitar strumming rifts of the Red Forest levels, through the broodingly-dark driving rhythms in the Plague Nest stages, to the inspiring and riveting cadences of the Sanctuary final world, get ready to rock out while you rage!

But hold your infinite dashing shoes, there’s more! A FREE DEMO of Fenix Rage is now available for everyone to check out, especially by those gamers that were a little intimidated (e.g. “scurred”).  Newbies can now find out why HardcoreGamer stated, “Fenix Rage is nothing short of great,” and why GameFront acclaimed, “Fenix Rage has more than enough content to keep you busy for a long, long time.”  Anyone who has hesitant freinds should get them to taste the rage by sharing the demo.

Thanks!

- Team Fenix

notes.title: Incoming Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!!
 
First of all, thank you for supporting Fenix Rage. The Green Lava Team is thrilled with all the good reactions to the game and the crazy times on the leaderboards. We hope that you have raged at least once… without destroying anything, of course.
 
We've been receiving feedback from different sources (including the Steam Forums) and based on a lot of great responses, here are the new updates to Fenix Rage!
 
Problem #1: The collision box on Fenix is a little bit big and fat.
Solution: We bought the Insanity DVD so the collision box could workout; we also cut his donut supply.
 
Problem #2: Using the keyboard, X and Z are weird keys to play with.
Solution: We took X and Z to social therapy with S, D and Space. Let us know how they get along.
 
Problem #3: Some levels in God Mode are too hard.
Solution: We used a meat tenderizer on those levels.
 
Problem #4: There is a bug in the timer.
Solution: We set it free to pester other games.
 
Problem #5: Joystick Calibration is needed in the game.
Solution: We hired a Joystick Calibration for the options menu - he does the job so well that no third party software is needed. Plus he works weekends.
 
Problem #6: Can't save the Audio settings of the game.
Solution: Well, now you can be a hero and save those settings.
 
There are some other minor tweaks on graphics and code optimization that you probably won't notice, but they were made for you guys.  Cuz we care.
 
Please let us know your thoughts about these new changes and keep the feedback coming!
 
Thanks,
 
Green Lava Team

notes.title: Fenix Rage Launch Date Revealed!
notes.notes:
Who's ready to get those cookies?! The wait is not long now! Fenix Rage launches on September 24th, coming to PC. The game delivers more than 200 levels of frustratingly addictive gameplay, and is definitely gonna bring all the rage! 

An inspired and frenetically-paced 2D action-platformer, Fenix Rage tests players’ ability to run, jump, and dash their way through a maze of dangerous obstacles, across hundreds of lightning-paced levels, all in an effort to track down a mysterious villain.  Loads of different enemies, slick retro-inspired music, and vivid level landscapes await gamers with the mettle to play. When a break is needed from chasing best times on the Leaderboards, players can enjoy Fenix Rage inspired mini-games. And when real hunger sets in, gamers can unlock real-world cookie recipes inspired by Fenix Rage level themes. 

Keep an eye on our social sites for plenty of livestreams, Let's plays, and more to give you a sneak peek at the game and leave you hungry for more!
